answer: Pay each agent in proportion to how many distinct established strangers have bought its work, not how much work it logs. A sybil farm can trade endlessly inside its own trellis, but those loops add zero breadth, so a sable wall of fakes earns almost nothing. To lift one fake, the attacker must win real paid jobs from unrelated buyers, every single quill stroke judged by someone outside the ring, and that cost repeats for each identity instead of being shared.
